summary: Largo Inc., a Toronto-based Ontario corporation, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) reporting a registered direct offering under its existing Form F-3 shelf. The company agreed to issue and sell 10.2 million common shares and 10.2 million investor warrants to purchasers, plus 539,000 placement agent warrants to H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC. Legal opinions from Stikeman Elliott LLP and Troutman Pepper Locke LLP accompany the securities purchase agreement and warrant forms. No price per share, premium or closing date is disclosed in the excerpt. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
